statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-70188 (GHSA-fpq8-4vhr-rcxx) is an ASP.NET Core security feature bypass in Kestrel (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core): Kestrel accepts newline characters in HTTP/2 request trailers and in values taken from the dynamic HPACK table instead of rejecting them as malformed. Microsoft lists the ASP.NET Core 10.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.12 and fixed in 10.0.13 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fpq8-4vhr-rcxx, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/462, https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/discussions/69798, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's dotnet/dotnet source release, and each build's version is the .NET release it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: every build ships Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.dll at its own .NET version, in the ASP.NET Core shared framework of aspnetcore10-runtime and of the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and in the ASP.NET Core runtime pack and the ASP.NET Core runtime archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap; the other copies are reference assemblies with no implementation code. That version is 10.0.2 to 10.0.10 in the first nine builds and 10.0.13 or later from 10.0.13-r0 on. The range ends at 10.0.13-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
